No interface, no text, no numbers, no icons, no circles, no marks and no logo on the screen - only the picture. Nothing else changes. No text overlays, no captions, no watermark.

Y1n.why: start of the inside-skin block: channels open, drops on the surface, nothing inside
Y1n.prompt:
Scientific hair-care illustration. Reproduce the first reference image exactly: the same composition and camera, the same large hair fibre on the left with its follicle and bulb, the same rounded cells of the upper layer and pink wavy fibres of the deeper layer, the same four short tapered micro-channels in the same places, the same blurred hairs in the background, the same soft warm light and the same empty softly blurred right side.
Change only one thing: this is the same illustration a few seconds earlier, when the golden serum has only just been dripped onto the scalp. The small golden droplets sit on the scalp surface above the four micro-channels; the micro-channels are open, clean and empty - no gold inside them. Below the scalp surface there is no gold at all: no golden mist, no particles, no golden film inside the tissue; the deeper layer is calm and pink; the hair bulb does not glow and has the same soft peach colour as the tissue around it; there is no golden trace along the hair.
Nothing else changes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no icons, no borders, no watermark, no instruments, no people.

T4b.prompt: The clip starts exactly on the first image and ends exactly on the last image: one continuous shot inside the same bright treatment room, filmed in a single take, no cut, no fade. For the first second the scene is as in the first image: a white-gloved hand holds one closed glass ampoule upright, sharp in the near foreground, perfectly still; the two women behind it are far out of focus. Then one calm action: the hand lowers the ampoule and carries it down and out of the frame at the lower left corner. As it leaves, the focus moves back to the two women, who become sharp, and the camera moves slowly forward to a closer shot of the cosmetologist leaning over the top of the patient's head. Then both of her gloved hands come up from below the frame, each already holding its tool: one hand holds a slim champagne-gold pen with a rose-gold ring, held at a slant like a pencil, and sets its lower end on the pale line of the parting in the patient's hair, between the two black hair clips; the other hand holds a small slim plastic syringe without a needle, pointing down a few centimetres above the parting beside the pen, with one clear drop at its tip. The patient sits still, head bowed, eyes closed, calm. In the last half second the picture settles exactly into the last image and holds still. While the ampoule is in the frame it stays closed, intact and unchanged; it leaves only in her hand, across the lower left frame edge. From the moment the pen and the syringe enter the frame they have exactly the shape, colours and print they have in the last image and never change shape; the pen has no cable; the syringe has no needle. The two women are the same two people in every frame: their faces, their hair, the straight parting, the two black hair clips, the brown headband, the white gloves and their clothes never change. Every frame is one solid photographic image: never a cross-fade, a dissolve, a double exposure, a ghost image or a transparent overlay. Nothing appears out of thin air and nothing turns into something else; no other objects; no blood, no red dots; no text or captions. Smooth, steady, slow; photorealistic; soft natural daylight.

The two women are the same two people in every frame: their faces, their hair, the straight parting, the two black hair clips, the brown headband, the white gloves and their clothes never change. No hair falls or moves out of place. Every frame is one solid photographic image: never a cross-fade, a dissolve, a double exposure, a ghost image or a transparent overlay. The patient does not move for the whole shot. The cosmetologist keeps the handset resting on the pale line of the hair parting with one hand and holds it still there.
The camera moves from the very first frame: it glides slowly and smoothly to the left and downward and pulls back a little. During the second half of the move the cosmetologist turns her eyes to the screen and calmly reaches her free gloved hand to the tablet, pointing with her index finger at one spot of the picture; she holds the pointing gesture. Nobody stands up, turns away or looks at the camera.
The move ends exactly on the last frame and the last half second is still. The picture on the tablet screen is a plain photographic camera view the whole time: no circles, no marks, no drawn lines, no interface, no text, no numbers.
Every frame is one solid photographic image: never a cross-fade, a dissolve, a double exposure or a ghost image. Soft daylight, the same room throughout. No text overlays, no captions, no logos.

E3b.replaces: E3 (the follow-up scan -> the end of the visit)
E3b.prompt:
One continuous shot with no cuts, no dissolves and no fades. It begins exactly as the first frame: in the left foreground a tablet on a small white table; behind it a cosmetologist in white gloves holds a white handset on the hair parting of a seated patient and points with her other hand at the tablet screen.
From the first frame the camera rises and glides forward and to the right, past the tablet, which slides out of the lower left corner of the frame and is not seen again; the two women stay in sharp focus.
During the first second the cosmetologist draws her pointing hand back and lifts the handset off the patient's head, lowering it out of the frame to the lower left. Then she takes one calm step to stand beside the chair, on the patient's right-hand side as we see it at the left of the frame, and brings her gloved hands together in front of her. At the same time the patient slowly raises her head, turns it a little toward the cosmetologist and looks up at her with a light, relaxed smile. The movements are slow and continuous; nobody leaves the frame.
The shot ends exactly on the last frame and the last half second is still. Every frame is one solid photographic image: never a cross-fade, a dissolve, a double exposure or a ghost image. Soft daylight, the same room throughout. No text overlays, no captions, no logos.

D1c.replaces: D1b (the dive from the procedure into the skin)
D1c.prompt: One continuous shot, no cuts. The camera pushes in smoothly and quickly from the treatment scene toward the pale parting line on the top of the head, right beside the lower end of the pen, glides down between the hairs to the scalp surface, and the view opens into a clean scientific hair-care illustration: a cut-away of the scalp with one hair fibre in its follicle and, beside it, four short narrow micro-channels in the upper layer, with small golden serum droplets resting on the scalp surface above them. The inside of the cut-away is calm and pink, with no gold inside yet. Continuous camera move with natural motion blur in the middle, slowing down smoothly; the last second is nearly still and equals the last frame. Soft warm daylight, no text, no captions, no arrows.

BL3.prompt: Scientific hair-care illustration, one continuous shot, locked framing with an almost imperceptible slow push-in. The golden serum droplets on the scalp surface sink slowly into the four short micro-channels beneath them and fill each one with a soft golden glow, from the top down. When the gold reaches the pointed tips of the micro-channels it does not go on as lines: it seeps out and spreads as a soft golden mist of fine sparkling particles through the deeper layer, widening slowly and drifting toward the hair bulb. The mist reaches the bulb and the bulb begins to glow warm gold. A thin golden film stays on the surface and soaks only very slightly into the topmost cells. Organic, liquid, unhurried motion; the tissue, the hair and the micro-channels stay still. No straight beams, no cuts, no text, no captions.

D2c.replaces: D2b (runs backwards in the film: back from the skin to the procedure)
D2c.prompt:
One continuous shot with no cuts, no dissolves and no fades. It begins exactly as the first frame: a cosmetologist in white gloves holds a microneedling pen at a slant on the hair parting of a seated patient and a small syringe beside it. The two women do not change their poses; hands and heads stay where they are.
Only the camera moves: it pushes in fast and smoothly toward the hair parting right beside the lower end of the pen - a macro dive. The dark hair strands grow large and sweep past the lens, the pale skin of the scalp fills the frame, and the camera comes down to the level of the skin surface among the hairs. The view settles on the last frame: one hair growing out of its follicle with the skin in front of it cut away, beside it four short narrow micro-channels filled with softly glowing golden serum, and a soft golden mist of fine particles spreading from their tips through the deeper layer to the gently glowing hair bulb.
The move accelerates gently, has natural motion blur in the middle and slows down smoothly; the last second is nearly still and equals the last frame. The light stays bright, warm and beige throughout. No text, no captions, no logos, no arrows, no needles shown in the close-up.
